Antigone is in probably the roughest shape out of the entire party, including Essek! They are STRUGGLING in serious ways. They are not a warrior, and they barely even wanted to go to war, much less take on Arkonil and his generals, ALONE, and there's a giant demon portal covering the world, this is not good at all.
In addition to this, they wanted to avoid their mother at all costs, and now they're walking right into her in Ironpetal. They are, distraught.

So where is this going? Audrey has outlined to me that she is considering Antigone joining their mother or running away. This ties directly into Catherine and her activity so let's get that figured out here, but first let's finish who Antigone is.

**Antigone's Father**.
Antigone has never known who their father was, and that was intentional by Catherine. All of her children have different fathers, because she was trying to create something special with her babies (we will touch on this more later). The secret she has kept from Antigone is that they are the child of Catherine Rex and Adrithyr Realmcrest. She met when Adrithyr was sent to eliminate her family over a hundred years ago, and they enjoyed fighting one another, eventually she seduced him and they became lovers for a short time before she was forced to flee by Queen Annabelle Mournraine.
Catherine raised Antigone alone, hoping for their draconic and vampiric bloodlines to create a perfect warrior, it worked but not to the effect she had hoped, so she continued her work.

**What is Catherine up to**?
Catherine saw the potential in Antigone but knew they lacked the cruelty and capacity for violence that she desired in a warrior. She had a new child (father still undecided), and is planning to complete the binding of draconic and vampiric power. The Realmcrest family seal dragon souls in their bodies from eggs, to grant them their powers. Catherine wants to this with a living dragon, Bloodwing, an already perfect symbiosis of dragon and vampire, into a vampire child of her blood, and create the perfect creature of the night. This is her plan, but where does it come from?

**Who is Catherine Rex, and why is she doing this**? 
Catherine is similar to Carmilla from Castlevania. She is a powerful and intelligent woman, who has been abused and mistreated by the male dominated political structure for almost her entire very long life, and she is tired of it. She saved Ivar to use him, and get herself the safety and resources of the King of Arkonia, and she plans to kill him and every other ruler that tries to control her. She wants the long prophesied within the vampire clans, "Daughter of the Blood Moon" as her personal killing machine, and will use it to enforce her rule and prevent her from ever being subjugated by a man again.

**What does this mean for Antigone**?
After all of that we can finally return to Antigone and what this means for them going forward. Catherine wants Antigone on her side, because while she is crazy and violent and a monster, she loves her children in a twisted way. She will try to convince Antigone to join her first through their sister Scarlett (who won't do a good job because she is jealous of Antigone), and then through her own words. She will say that she can bring about an end to all wars and begin a new paradise with Antigone's help. She will say that they need to fight demons with a demon of their own, and that she can save the world if they will just join her. This is where it gets sticky. She may also mention who their father is to try to build common ground.

**If Antigone joins Catherine**.
This is an outright betrayal of the party, and it may end in a fight. Catherine will not work with the other Young Wolves, as she does not trust them because they are not vampires nor family. She does have a Runestone that will teleport Antigone her and the baby away if they are touching, taking them to "somewhere safe". It could be really cool if there was a fight. When Antigone departs from the party, Ryfon will arrive shortly after to rejoin the gang.

**If Antigone stays true to the Young Wolves**.
This is a developing moment of bravery, standing in the face of the woman that terrified them for so long and saying, "I won't join you." It is healing and it is epic. She is enraged, and will attempt to flee as quickly as possible. She could probably kill one of the party members before she leaves, but would rather protect the child and get out.

**How does it happen**?
Antigone will get grabbed, separated from the party by Scarlett and brought before Catherine, where they will plead with them to stop fighting and join them, because they need Antigone's abilities to control the child. They will do this interaction alone, and the party will find them either allied with Catherine, or ready to fight back.
